messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — opened a PR to clean up a few edge-case examples in the model catalog and fix a couple of broken links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

kevin: Thanks. Quick Q — does this change the supported variants list for stratus6b? I noticed a new compat note about quantized variants.

maria: Yes. We're clarifying that some int4/int8 variants are listed but may fallback to CPU on older kernels. Added an explicit "compatibility" bullet and a short bench summary.

ara: Can you add a tiny SDK snippet showing the fallback behavior so users can see how to detect it? e.g., check `response.runtime` or error code.

maria: Draft snippet added to the PR:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate("Summarize the release notes", model="stratus6b:quant-int8")
print(resp.text)
if getattr(resp, "runtime", "") != "gpu":
    print("Runtime fallback: ", resp.runtime)
```

samir: Nit: the catalog uses `model="stratus6b:quant-int8"`, good call. Also we should mention sequence_limit (4096) and the p95 numbers for that profile.

maria: Added sequence_limit: 4096 and p95 numbers (see bench table). Also noted that enabling `batch_window` can reduce cost but increases median latency.

docs-bot: New PR opened by maria: #482 — reviewers requested: @kevin @ara @samir

kevin: Left a couple inline comments on the benchmark methodology — can you attach raw run logs or a gist of the perf runs? I want to sanity check the client-side timings.

maria: Gist uploaded: https://gist.github.com/maria/bench-482 (includes run script and raw csv)

ara: Looks clearer now. One more ask: add a short migration note for Dedicated customers about autoscale and pinned capacity interactions (so teams know why they might see different latencies).

maria: Added a 3-line migration note under "Dedicated" section. Anyone can proofread compatibility paragraph?

samir: I can do a quick pass this afternoon.

kevin: I'll double-check the bench numbers tomorrow morning.

maria: Thanks — I'll iterate and push one more commit, then request reviews. Also fixed a broken link: /models/stratus -> /catalog/stratus6b (was a stale anchor).

ara: Small style nit: headings should follow sentence case per docs style guide.

maria: Updated headings to sentence case (:white_check_mark:).

samir: After merge, let's ping support to update the KB and the Dedicated runbook.

maria: Added changelog entry and created a support todo card.

kevin: Great — thanks for moving fast on this. :rocket:

maria: Will request final reviews once I squash the bench commit and add a short `how we measured` blurb.

(END)
